regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows Tech Hardware & Semis as the theme leader with low breadth (0.167) and a mild negative recent return, but it is eligible via the absolute-trend gate and not crowded. Four other themes (Conglomerates, Banks, High-Dividend Blue Chips, Industrials) also pass the trend gate, signalling lower drawdown risk. Macro narrative is heavily skewed toward AI/tech, which could support but not predict the leader. No single dominant narrative or confirmed handoff; the structure is narrowing with room for a shake-out. All evidence is coincident, so any lean is a conditional judgement, not an edge extraction.
emerging_watch: Diversified Miners (rank 2, score 1.43) is ineligible but close behind the leader. If it becomes eligible and its durability bar rises above 0.5 while Tech Hardware & Semis loses eligibility, that would signal a confirmed leadership handoff. Kill criterion: If miners' rank score falls below 0.5 or fails to gain eligibility within the next 10 trading days, the watch is over.

theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The theme sits at rank 1 with positive momentum score, is eligible (suggesting the trend is robust enough to avoid whipsaw), and is not crowded. The macro narrative's AI/tech focus provides a coincident attention tailwind, while the absolute-trend gate suggests lower volatility risk while the trend persists. The low breadth is a warning, but the thesis is that leadership will hold as long as the trend does not break.
evidence: Rank 1 with score 1.483 (focus lens, not prediction)
Eligible: true (absolute-trend gate signals lower drawdown risk)
Crowded: false (no reflexivity cap even if we could size)
Macro narrative 37 AI/tech mentions in 5 days (coincident reinforcement)
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.167 means very few stocks are driving the theme; a rotation out of the narrow group could reverse quickly. The r10 is slightly negative, hinting at fatigue. If the AI narrative fades or geopolitics overrides, the theme lacks internal resilience.

falsifier.text: Momentum score (rank score) crosses below zero and stays there for 5 consecutive trading days, OR breadth drops under 0.10, indicating the trend has broken internally.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: This theme is eligible, has the highest durability bar (0.71) among the top ten, very high breadth (0.875), and is not crowded. The Hurst tag 'trend' suggests a low-risk carry while the macro environment is uncertain. It serves as a defensive allocation that can compound steadily if the trend holds, without needing to call a rotation.
theses.dissent: In a market where growth/tech is the dominant meta-narrative, high-dividend blue chips could be a value trap if yields compress or if a sharp risk-on rally kicks in. The trend could stall under a sudden policy shock that lifts growth cyclicals.

falsifier.text: Eligibility drops to false (trend gate turns off) OR the rank score falls below -0.3 for more than 10 trading days, signalling the trend has decayed.
